title: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe
summary: Bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae and viruses: invisible living things that make curd and idli, recycle waste, feed crops, spoil food and cause disease. Learn to use them and to keep them in check.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Microorganisms change the world around us; understanding their interactions lets us use them sustainably and protect our health.

factual: What are the main groups of microorganisms?
How do microbes make curd, idli and bread?
How do antibiotics work, and why don't they work on viruses?
conceptual: How do decomposers and nitrogen-fixing bacteria keep ecosystems in balance?
How do preservation methods stop microbes from spoiling food?
debatable: Should antibiotics be sold only with a doctor's prescription?
Are microbes more friend or foe to humans?
